unit.title: Polynomial Operations and Special Products
unit.act: Act VII - Building expressions from powers
unit.role: Develop the forward multiplication machinery needed for factoring and quadratics.
unit.governingQuestion: How can expressions built from powers be combined systematically?
unit.storyArc: Polynomials are classified and evaluated, then combined through distribution. Product grids and geometry reveal special products. Division completes the reversible arithmetic of polynomials.
outcomes: Use exponent laws within monomial operations.
Recognize binomial squares and difference-of-squares products.
Perform polynomial division and verify by multiplication.
unit.investigation: Represent the same polynomial product with distribution, a product grid, and an area model.
unit.mastery: Mixed polynomial operations with missing powers, signs, and verification by reverse operations.
